run_convert_pdf_to_markdown: run the docling CLI to convert PDF documents to Markdown output format
run_convert_pdf_with_ocr: run the docling CLI to convert PDF files with OCR enabled and specify OCR language
run_convert_pdf_to_json_html: run the docling CLI to convert PDF documents to JSON and HTML export formats
run_convert_audio_with_whisper: run the docling CLI to convert audio files using ASR pipeline with Whisper model
run_convert_pdf_with_vlm: run the docling CLI to convert PDF documents using VLM pipeline with SmolDocling model
